comment: REQUIRED when landing a new plugin skill (e.g. cloudbase-perf-review). Copy the object under skills into plugin/cloudbase/skill-metadata.json. The key MUST equal the directory name plugin/cloudbase/skills/<dir>. Then run npm run build:skill-manifest (CLI fails if the entry is missing). Do not rely on SKILL.md frontmatter — sync overwrites it. Optional injectionCost (bytes) overrides description-length budget estimates when the hook only injects a Skill() pointer.

phrases: example phrase unique to this skill

examples: example user prompt that should trigger this skill
